newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg/mark seen heading just above 2.79.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg/mark seen heading just above 2.79.

text.p: Sterling is expected to consolidate against the mark before attempting a push towards highs just above 2.79 marks, said analysts.
"Sterling is in a continuation pattern," said Nick Shamin, technical analyst at Technical Data.

He said sterling/mark was likely to pick-up speed after a brief respite and attempt to test the top of a triangle formation around highs at 2,7920 marks. A break of the 2,7920-mark area will encourage sterling to scale towards 2,8235-mark peaks, he added. At 0748 GMT sterling/mark was trading at 2.7863/73 against 2.7870/80 in late Europe on Thursday.
Shamin said the triangle formation was bullish for sterling - especially if highs at 2,7920-marks were breached.
Further gains, however, will be capped at the 2.80-mark and 2.8040/60-mark levels, said analysts.
"We continue to warn that short-term gains will be unsustainable and from levels below 2,8440 it should move south again," said the technical team at Chase's technical team.
Cable is also expected to remain rangebound on Friday, with sterling seeming a touch toppy against the dollar, said analysts.
RSI - 14 day: Stg/mark: 55 pct, Stg/dollar: 49 pct
